blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Water levels at five of the nine monitored dams across the country slightly increased in the past 24 hours, according to the state weather bureau. In its latest update issued at 8 a.m., the Philippine Atmospheric, Geophysical, and Astronomical Services Administration (Pagasa) said the dams were La Mesa, Ambuklao, Binga, Pantabangan and Caliraya. READ: ITCZ to bring rains, thunderstorms over much of PH on Sunday Binga Dam in Benguet saw the biggest increase at 0.40 meters (m), from 573.79 m on Saturday to 574.19 m on Sunday.
